# AssembleAtEase

> AssembleAtEase LLC is a Texas home-setup service: furniture assembly, TV and wall mounting, smart home installation, fitness equipment, outdoor and playset assembly, and office furniture assembly. Customers book online at a fixed price shown before booking, and a local pro comes to the home with the tools.

- Services: Furniture Assembly, Mounting & Hanging, Smart Home, Fitness Equipment, Outdoor & Playsets, Office Assembly, and custom quotes for anything else.
- Where: Texas. Core areas are the Austin metro and the San Antonio metro, where a local pro is matched automatically. Other Texas ZIP codes can book and are confirmed by our team.
- Prices: fixed and itemized per piece, shown before booking. Texas sales tax is added at checkout.
- Payment: you pay after the work is done. A hold for the total is placed on your card before the appointment.
- Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the appointment. Inside 24 hours, once a pro has accepted the job, a 10% fee on the service price applies, or 15% when the pro is already on the way or it is under 2 hours. No fee applies if no pro has accepted. A booking that was rescheduled no longer has the free window.
- Custom quotes: no card is needed to ask. We email a price; you approve it and add a card to book.
- The pros (called Easers) are independent contractors who bring their own tools.
- Contact: (979) 232-5139, service@assembleatease.com. Phone and email hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM; Saturday, 7 AM to 1 PM. Booking online is open any time.

## Services

- [Furniture Assembly](https://www.assembleatease.com/furniture-assembly-austin-tx): from $69. Popular: Sectional sofa (L-shape) $159; Bed frame — queen $119; IKEA PAX wardrobe (single unit) $199.
- [Mounting & Hanging](https://www.assembleatease.com/tv-mounting-austin-tx): from $79. Popular: TV 41"–55" (standard wall) $119; In-wall cord concealment $199; Gallery wall — 6–10 pieces $165; Curtain rod — 2 windows $119.
- [Smart Home](https://www.assembleatease.com/smart-home-installation-austin-tx): from $69. Popular: Smart thermostat — Nest, Ecobee, Honeywell $99; Smart doorbell — wireless / battery-powered $89; Camera system — 4 cameras $279.
- [Fitness Equipment](https://www.assembleatease.com/fitness-equipment-assembly-austin-tx): from $139. Popular: Treadmill assembly $219.
- [Outdoor & Playsets](https://www.assembleatease.com/playset-assembly-austin-tx): from $109. Popular: Swing set / backyard playset assembly $349.
- [Office Assembly](https://www.assembleatease.com/office-furniture-assembly-austin-tx): from $89. Popular: Desk (L-shape / executive) $179.
- [Custom quote](https://www.assembleatease.com/book): anything not listed. No card needed to request a price.

## Room-Ready Bundles

- [Bedroom Ready](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=bedroom-ready): Bed built, dresser assembled, nightstand placed — the bedroom handled in one visit.
- [Living Room Ready](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=living-room-ready): TV mounted, media console built, cords tidied — a living room that looks finished.
- [Home Office Ready](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=home-office-ready): Desk and chair built, cables managed — sit down and get to work.
- [Move-In Setup](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=move-in-ready): New place, handled — bed, sofa, and TV set up so you can settle in. Add anything else you need.
- [Smart Entry Setup](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=smart-entry-setup): Video doorbell, smart lock, and a camera installed and set up on your phone.
- [Nursery Setup](https://www.assembleatease.com/book?bundle=nursery-setup): Crib, dresser, and storage built and anchored — the nursery ready for baby.
